title: Bound broad repository exploration before context growth

context_item.content: For regressions involving shared inheritance or object layout, begin with the issue-introducing version boundary and the nearest shared base classes. Create one focused reproduction before scanning all subclasses. Stop expanding the repository-wide census once a direct mechanism is identified. Apply the smallest fix, run the focused regression first, then run the relevant regression suite.

does_not_apply_when: The failure is already isolated to a leaf implementation.
The task is unrelated to Python class behavior or shared abstractions.
